name: openclaw
description: OpenClaw (MIT, github.com/openclaw/openclaw) on oci-apps — the open-source personal agent gateway, as a fourth fleet agent next to hermes, goose and claude. Upstream's own image, unmodified. Its gateway listens on 127.0.0.1 only (host network, auth mode none, the documented trusted-loopback setup) with the OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions enabled; the fleet reaches it ONLY through the agent gateway my-ai-api (X-Agent-Mode: openclaw). Its model calls go back through that same gateway's OpenRouter face, which holds the key, so this service has no secret at all. Never public, never on the mesh directly.

runtime._comment: THE ONE DECLARATION of what OpenClaw runs. src/openclaw-config.nix renders configs/openclaw.json from it (a pure function, evaluated by the tester too), compose.nix mounts that read-only and the container copies it into its state volume at every start, so a hand edit inside the container lasts until the next restart and never longer. `model` is the fleet's agent model (the same one goose and hermes declare); `provider` is the fleet gateway's OpenAI-compatible face on the WireGuard bind, which injects the OpenRouter key — the apiKey OpenClaw sends is a placeholder the gateway ignores (passthrough_auth false there).
runtime._bind_comment: loopback + auth none is the setup OpenClaw documents for a trusted same-host caller (docs/gateway/config-gateway.md: 'auth.mode none — use only for trusted local loopback setups'). Any other bind REQUIRES auth (non-loopback binds refuse to start without it) and would need a shared token in both this service's and my-ai-api's sops files; the tester fails if bind leaves loopback while auth stays none.

app._image_comment: Upstream's public GHCR image, pinned (2026.9.9 = latest on 2026-10-10, arm64 digest sha256:f75083cde787fcb90cdfa91cb17ca0ea135b5f4ee989fc08ca2c2e12abe22e84). Public, so the oci-apps pull needs no GHCR login. 3.4 GB on disk.

resources._comment: Measured 2026-10-10 on oci-apps (smoke run of this exact config): 1.33 GiB resident after one agent turn. 3G is the ceiling with headroom for tool runs; the agi category default (8G) is more than this service needs.

app._healthcheck_comment: null on purpose, as for cloud-agi-hermes: the listener is loopback-only, so a mesh probe of openclaw.app:18789 could only ever fail. Liveness is compose.nix's container healthcheck (127.0.0.1/health) and the gateway's /health.modes[openclaw].available.
